value.rationale: There is a natural recovery question for the full multiplicity-weighted excedance-set distribution on the Boolean group. Invertibility in the entire n=3 mod 4 class might be inferred from n=3,7,11,15; n=19 is its first exact counterexample, with a nontrivial 24-mode nullspace and exact sharp recovery conditioning, established by complete first-nineteen-order census rather than an arbitrary slice.
